observation_summary: RSI token efficiency report: goldenbuild per-source cache + RSI history limit
actions_taken: Analyzed token spend across emily-agent RSI loop, obs-watcher, and prime-task dispatch. Found two high-ROI improvements: (1) goldenbuild.go was recompressing all 16 golden sources on every rebuild even when only 1-2 changed — added per-source SHA-256 content cache (golden-cache.json) so unchanged sources skip the haiku call, saving ~13-14 haiku calls per rebuild; (2) rsi.go buildGenerationPrompt was including all N-1 iteration records in the prompt for iteration N — capped history at last 3 iterations, saving ~150 tokens per omitted record on long tasks.

emily_agent_rsi_loop_per_cycle.goldenbuild_rebuild: 16 sources × (500 input + 400 output) = ~14,400 haiku tokens per rebuild; fires when any source changes (mtime-based). Estimated 3-5 rebuilds/day = 43K-72K haiku tokens/day.
emily_agent_rsi_loop_per_cycle.rsi_iteration_per_iter: 4096 max gen output + 3072 max eval output = 7168 max output/iter. Actual typically 500-2000. Input grows ~150 tokens per prior iteration record.
emily_agent_rsi_loop_per_cycle.extract_lessons: ~512 max output + ~1500 input; fires only on multi-iteration task completion.
emily_agent_rsi_loop_per_cycle.prime_triage_per_cycle: haiku call via runPrimeTriage; cost depends on observation count. Estimated 500-2000 tokens/cycle.

observation_watcher_per_dispatch.claude_code_session: 100K-200K tokens per session (Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md, reads files, runs tools, commits). Dominant cost center.
observation_watcher_per_dispatch.prompt_overhead: ~450 tokens runReportFooter + ~200 task context per dispatch. Negligible vs session cost.
observation_watcher_per_dispatch.dedup_guard: primeDedupWindow=4h prevents same type+description from firing more than once per 4h. Already effective.

current_spend_analysis.prime_task_dispatch: Same as obs-watcher: 100K-200K tokens per Claude Code session.

improvements.title: Goldenbuild per-source content cache
improvements.description: Previously: every rebuild recompressed all 16 golden sources via haiku regardless of what changed. Fixed: per-source SHA-256 hash stored in context/golden-cache.json; only sources with changed content trigger a haiku call. Unchanged sources reuse their cached compressed section.
improvements.estimated_savings: 14 haiku calls avoided per rebuild when 1-2 sources change. At 5 rebuilds/day: ~70 haiku calls/day × (500 input + 400 output tokens) = ~63K haiku tokens/day saved. Monthly: ~1.9M haiku tokens.

improvements.title: RSI iteration history limit (last 3)
improvements.description: Previously: all N-1 prior iteration records were included in the generation prompt for iteration N, growing ~150 tokens per record. Fixed: only the last 3 iterations are included; older ones are summarized as '[N omitted]'. The last iteration's NextFocus is the only actionable signal; older records have diminishing returns.
improvements.estimated_savings: ~150 tokens per omitted iteration. For a 10-iter task: saves ~900 input tokens (iterations 5-10 each carry fewer records). At 50 RSI tasks/month with avg 7 iters: ~150K tokens/month.

improvements.title: Extend rsi_report prime-task dedup window to 8h
improvements.description: rsi_report tasks are expensive (100K-200K tokens/session) and the report output is unlikely to differ significantly if re-run within 8h. Extending from 4h to 8h halves the frequency of redundant rsi_report dispatches.
improvements.estimated_savings: ~100K-200K tokens per avoided session. At 1 avoided session/2 days: ~50K-100K tokens/day.

improvements.title: Compress runReportFooter in obs-watcher
improvements.description: The runReportFooter adds ~450 tokens of boilerplate to every Claude Code dispatch. Many instructions (CHANGELOG, git commit, Apple) are also in CLAUDE.md. Could be reduced to ~150 tokens with a concise reference-style footer.
improvements.estimated_savings: ~300 tokens × 4 dispatches/day = ~1,200 tokens/day. Low priority given 100K+ session size.

notes: goldenbuild cache is stored at EMILY/context/golden-cache.json (gitignored recommended — it contains compressed content but not source material). The RSI history limit uses maxHistoryIters=3 which is tunable. Both changes are backwards-compatible.
